Description
Our client, a German insurance group with 17 legal entities, is consolidating four SAP ECC systems into a single SAP S/4HANA Finance instance. Central Finance is used as the transition platform before the full cut-over in 2027. We are looking for an experienced SAP FI/CO consultant to take over the finance data migration workstream.

Your tasks
• Configure and stabilise the Central Finance replication (initial load, real-time replication, error handling in AIF)
• Map charts of accounts, cost centre and profit centre hierarchies via SAP MDG
• Plan and run the mock loads and the reconciliation of balances, open items and asset values
• Customizing of FI-GL, FI-AA and CO-OM in the target system
• Support the SAP Group Reporting team with the data model for the consolidation
• Coordinate with accounting, controlling and the offshore delivery team in Pune

Requirements
• At least 8 years of experience as SAP FI/CO consultant, including two S/4HANA Finance implementations
• Hands-on experience with Central Finance (CFIN) and the SAP Migration Cockpit
• Solid knowledge of new asset accounting and the Universal Journal
• Experience in insurance or banking is an advantage (FS-CD is not required)
• Fluent German and English; workshops are held in German

Conditions
Location: Frankfurt am Main, two days per week on site, the rest remote
Start: 01.11.2026, duration 10 months, extension likely
Workload: full time
Contract: freelance under a service contract with us. This is not a temporary staffing assignment; Arbeitnehmerüberlassung (ANÜ) is excluded.
